suggestion: Decide how research numbers are shown. Today every model, ROI, p-value and correlation cell on the public leaderboard is blank because the inputs are community files, so the dashboard cannot rank anything.
evidence: pipeline/render_site.py prints BLANK for ROI, Adjusted p and Correlation on index.html and strategies.html; the numbers exist in assets/data/strategy_summary.csv.
options: A) Keep strict blanks. B) Add a clearly separated 'research estimate (community input, not official)' column beside the blank official column. C) Keep blanks on the dashboard, publish estimates only on the annex.
unblocks: A leaderboard that can actually be read and compared, without relabelling estimates as official.

suggestion: Obtain timestamped, executable sportsbook quotes (book, market, line, price, time, limit). Without them no ROI or closing-line value can be validated and gate G1 fails for every strategy.
evidence: data/processed/strategy_gates.csv: 18 of 18 strategies UNVERIFIED; verify_site.py asserts 'official quote gate fails without evidence'.
options: A) License a historical odds archive. B) Start forward capture now from a feed you are entitled to use, on the same scheduled runner as the availability tracker. C) Continue with community closing lines only.
recommended: B now, A if budget allows
unblocks: Gate G1, closing-line value, real ROI, parlay and prop pricing.

suggestion: Freeze the 18 strategy definitions and run them forward as a paper ledger: originated lines and selections are committed before kickoff, so the commit time is the proof that nothing was chosen with hindsight.
evidence: EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md lists 'untouched prospective replication' as missing; all current results are backtests on one archive.
options: A) Paper ledger for the rest of the 2026 season, review after the Super Bowl. B) Paper ledger for a full season before any award. C) No forward test.
recommended: A, then B before any real stake
unblocks: The only evidence that separates skill from a lucky backtest; makes the leaderboard a real competition.

suggestion: Refresh the pinned results-and-schedule snapshot on a schedule. The open line board was built from a snapshot pinned on 2026-11-02 and its first listed games are Week 8, already played.
evidence: data/sources.json generated_utc 2026-11-02; data/processed/originated_upcoming.csv starts at 2026 week 8 (gameday 2026-11-01).
options: A) Weekly automatic re-pin on Tuesday with the full verification suite as the gate. B) Re-pin only on request. C) Keep the frozen snapshot.
unblocks: Lines for the games that are actually upcoming; the availability table and the line board describe the same week.

suggestion: Decide how availability enters the originated line. The tracker now shows who is out and who is next on the club's depth chart, but the line model does not use it.
evidence: pipeline/models.py feature list (assets/data/feature_dict.csv) contains no injury or lineup field; availability.html is display-only.
options: A) Display-only until a backtest exists. B) Quarterback-only adjustment first. C) Position-group adjustment weighted by snaps.
recommended: A now; B after S-06 supplies history
unblocks: A line that reacts to a backup quarterback or a depleted secondary, with a measured rather than assumed effect.

suggestion: Build the history needed to measure injury effects. The scheduled tracker stores a dated copy of every capture from today forward; earlier seasons are not in the repository.
evidence: data/availability/history/ starts 2026-11-12; no earlier official snapshots exist in the repo.
options: A) Accumulate official snapshots only (slow, fully official). B) Also backfill earlier seasons from the community nflverse injury and depth-chart files, labelled community. C) Backfill from official game books.
recommended: A + B, with B labelled community
unblocks: Q-07 (what a missing starter is worth) and any injury-based signal.

suggestion: Capture game-day inactive lists and actual starters. The injury report and depth chart are pre-game expectations; the inactive list is what actually happened.
evidence: NFL.com publishes weekly inactives articles (linked); the tracker does not read them yet.
options: A) Add a game-day capture to the scheduled workflow. B) Read starters from play-by-play after the game only. C) Do nothing.
unblocks: Confirms whether the 2nd/3rd-string player really started; closes the loop for S-05.

suggestion: Decide how to handle a club whose depth chart cannot be read as text. At the first capture one club page (Houston) published its chart as an image, so its rows are blank and flagged.
options: A) Leave blank and flagged. B) Add image text recognition, flagged as machine-read. C) Use the previous game's starters from play-by-play.

suggestion: Obtain real prop prices and same-game-parlay quotes before ranking any prop combo. The prop module projects player lines but has no market price to compare against.
evidence: props.html and EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md: 'Verified player-prop prices and joint SGP quotes' missing; 0 verified prop-price tickets.
options: A) Capture prop quotes forward with S-02. B) Keep props as projections only. C) Drop props from the competition until prices exist.
unblocks: Prop-combo ROI, and a check of our correlation estimates against how books price correlated legs.

suggestion: Register every strategy variant before it is tested. The deflated Sharpe ratio needs the true number of trials, and that number is unknown for the earlier exploratory work.
evidence: flagged.html F-08: complete number of exploratory trials unknown; DSR provisional.
options: A) Append-only registry file checked by a test. B) Count only the 18 canonical strategies. C) Leave as is.
unblocks: Makes the multiple-testing correction honest for every future strategy.

suggestion: Define what the leaderboard reward is. The competition has gates and tiers but every reward is unawarded and no pool is defined.
evidence: strategy_gates.csv reward column is NONE for all 18; EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md: 'No funded prize pool'.
options: A) Recognition tiers only. B) Paper bankroll share for strategies that pass forward validation. C) Real stake after a full forward season.
recommended: B, moving to C only after S-03
unblocks: A competition with a defined prize and a defined way to win it.

suggestion: Consolidate the site. The repository carries three generations of pages (root, lab/, archive/) and three pipelines (pipeline/, scripts/, analysis/); the top navigation has grown past a dozen links.
evidence: Repository tree: 13+ root pages, lab/ (9 pages), archive/ (2 earlier sites), analysis/ and scripts/ alongside pipeline/.
options: A) Group navigation into Decide / Lines / Strategies / Availability / Evidence and keep everything. B) Also move analysis/ and the oldest site into archive/. C) Leave as is.
unblocks: A dashboard a reviewer can scan in a minute.

suggestion: Extend the official score check from a sample to every game. The scheduled runner can reach NFL.com (the availability tracker proves it), which the build sandbox could not.
evidence: data/audit/nfl_com_score_audit.csv: 39 games checked, 31 MATCH, 8 blank in the dataset while NFL.com shows a final.
options: A) Run a full census on the scheduled runner. B) Check each new week only. C) Keep the sample.
recommended: B now, A as a one-off
unblocks: Moves game results from community tier to officially checked.

suggestion: Change how parallel sessions claim work. Claims are pushed to each session's own branch, so sessions cannot see each other; the same request was claimed by several sessions on 2026-11-01 and again on 2026-11-12.
evidence: COORDINATION.md collision notices (2026-11-01 and 2026-11-12); open PR #19 has been in conflict since 2026-11-02.
options: A) Claims go to main in a one-line commit before any work. B) One session per request. C) Keep the current protocol and deduplicate at integration.
unblocks: No duplicate pages, smaller merges, one canonical answer.

suggestion: Capture pre-kickoff forecasts if weather is to be a feature. Weather fields were removed from the default model because their pre-game availability could not be verified.
options: A) Capture forecasts forward from an official meteorological service. B) Keep weather out of the model.
recommended: B until S-02 and S-03 are running
unblocks: Totals signals that depend on wind.

suggestion: Agree a staking rule before any real bet: fixed fraction, correlation-aware limits per game, and a stop rule. No such rule exists yet because nothing is validated.
evidence: The canonical pipeline/ defines no bankroll or staking parameter; only older annex and archive code mentions bankroll or Kelly terms.
options: A) Fixed small unit, one position per game. B) Fractional Kelly with a cap, correlated legs counted once. C) Defer.
recommended: C until a strategy passes forward validation
unblocks: Limits the damage of a false positive.

suggestion: Raise an alert when the tracker sees a first-listed quarterback, offensive lineman or defensive back designated Out or Doubtful.
evidence: data/availability/slot_status.csv already carries the flag column; nothing is sent anywhere.
options: A) Highlight on the dashboard only (done). B) Also open a GitHub issue per alert. C) Email or chat notification.
